rules.title: Type/const variable substitution
rules.statement: Monomorphization substitution maps a type position of kind TypeVar or ConstVar to the concrete type bound for its name in the active substitution map; an unbound variable is left unchanged.

rules.title: Substitution preserves identity when nothing changes
rules.statement: Substitution is structural and recursive over every type constructor (Array, Ptr/Ref/MutRef, Struct, Enum, Slice, Tuple, Fn/Closure, TraitObject, DstRef, etc.); when no contained component is altered by the map, the original type is returned unchanged rather than a fresh allocation.

rules.title: Array length from const-generic binding
rules.statement: For an array type [T; N] whose length is a symbolic const-generic name, substitution resolves N through the map: a binding with a concrete const value becomes a literal length; a binding that is still a ConstVar keeps a (renamed) symbolic length.

rules.title: Array length sizeof...(P) equals pack arity
rules.statement: An array length written as sizeof...(P) over a type-parameter pack P lowers to a special size marker; at monomorphization its literal length is set to the number of types in the concrete expansion of P.

rules.title: ?Sized binding to slice canonicalizes pointer to fat Slice
rules.statement: When a `?Sized` type parameter under a pointer/reference wrapper (&T, &mut T, *const T, *mut T) is bound to an UnsizedSlice<U>, the result is canonicalized to a fat-pointer Slice<U> (the slice fat-pointer ABI).

rules.title: ?Sized binding to dyn canonicalizes pointer to TraitObject
rules.statement: When a `?Sized` type parameter under a pointer/reference wrapper is bound to an UnsizedDyn (bare `dyn Trait`), the result is canonicalized to a TraitObject carrying the trait name and trait type-args (the dyn fat-pointer form).

rules.title: Pointer to DST struct canonicalizes to fat DstRef
rules.statement: A pointer/reference whose pointee substitutes to a struct (or zoned struct) that is a custom-DST — either because the struct template is flagged is_dst, or because this instantiation bound its bare unsized tail type-parameter to an unsized arg (UnsizedDyn, UnsizedSlice, or a bare `dyn` TraitObject of owning-kind Borrow) — is canonicalized to a fat DstRef carrying the struct name, package, mutability, and type-args.

rules.title: Raw pointer to self-describing DST stays thin
rules.statement: When the pointee struct is `#[self_describing]` (recovers its tail length from an in-band prefix field), a raw `*const Self`/`*mut Self` (kind Ptr) stays a thin 8-byte pointer and is NOT canonicalized to fat DstRef; `&Self`/`&mut Self` still take the fat representation.
rules.divergence: Logos-specific Writ/RefRepr self-describing-DST contract; no Rust analogue.

rules.title: Generic struct/enum type-arg substitution records instantiation
rules.statement: Substituting a Struct/ZonedStruct/Enum recurses into its type-args; the resulting concrete instantiation is recorded as a needed monomorphization. For enums the need is recorded even when no type-arg changed (e.g. a non-generic use of Option<i32>).

rules.title: Variadic tuple pack expansion
rules.statement: A tuple whose sole element is a TypeVar that maps to (or is a pack name in cur_packs_ of) a concrete tuple/type-list is spliced in place: the wrapper tuple's elements become the recursively-substituted elements of the bound list, so `(A...)` expands to `(T1, T2, ...)`.

rules.title: Fn/closure signature substitution
rules.statement: Substituting an FnItem, FnPtr, or Closure type recurses into each parameter type and the return type; signatures sharing the closure_params/closure_ret slots (e.g. `fn(T, U) -> V`) substitute their TypeVars accordingly.

rules.title: Associated-type projection resolution
rules.statement: An AssocType `<Base as Trait>::Name` is resolved by first substituting Base; once Base is a concrete struct, zoned struct, enum, or scalar primitive, the key Trait::ConcreteBase::Name is looked up in the recorded associated-type impls and the bound type is returned (with nested associated-type chains collapsed fully).

rules.title: Associated-type blanket-impl fallback
rules.statement: When no direct associated-type impl matches, an associated-type projection falls back to a blanket impl `impl<T: Bound> Trait for T` whose required bound (and all extra bounds) the concrete base recursively satisfies; the blanket's associated type is returned with its target type-var bound to the concrete base.

rules.title: CFG-slot type projection from Writ config
rules.statement: A CfgSlotType `<type:CFG.path>` resolves CFG (a const-generic param or inlined Writ static literal) to a WStaticLit, walks the encoded path (string-keyed 'F', int-keyed 'I' map fields and 'A' array indices joined by 0x1F) through the Writ value, and yields the type named at the terminal Type node (primitive, struct, or enum); if CFG is not yet concrete or any step misses, the projection stays deferred (unchanged).
rules.divergence: Logos-specific compile-time Writ-config-driven type projection; no Rust analogue.
